name: HDV Foundation — learned behavioral scorer (Phase 7, enforce mode)
description: Demonstrates the LEARNED behavioral scorer as a strictly ADDITIVE KNOLL gate. A pure-TS online logistic-regression model is trained on labeled SecurityAudit-like packets, then wired into the REAL APEX -> KNOLL transport in enforce mode (heuristic scorer off, so the learned denies are isolated). Hard laws still block law violations first; the learned scorer only ADDS denies for law-passing-but-suspicious traffic (accumulated soft-suspicious signal that is weaker than the hard LAW 6 block). Legal traffic must still route.
